name: Numata Ayako
source:
A 36 years old housewife.

Her hair is dyed blond and at first glance does not like a mother. Like her looks, she has a masculine and straightforward personality,

Her own son is a classmate of Kouta's. She does not feel that what she is doing is wrong and enjoys having sex with the boys at "mama club".

[From [url=http://www.complets.co.jp/complet's/mama-club2.html]official site[/url]]
